description: Send an explicit orchestrate turn. Omit threadId to start a thread; supply the returned threadId to continue. Use a stable clientMessageId for retries. This tool never automatically reclassifies the chosen mode. Execution and sensitive actions retain their authorization and approval requirements. Read progress with get_thread.

audience.description: Who consumes this response. Controls presentation only; never identity, permissions, or approval.

clientMessageId.description: A unique ID for this message. Reuse it only when retrying the same request.

files.description: PDFs or images, with base64 contents. Put Markdown text in context.text or user_memory.

text.description: Task details, constraints, budget, or deadline. This is not permission to spend.

conversationId.description: Omit to start a conversation; return this ID on follow-ups.

memoryAgentId.description: Read memory for an account agent you belong to. Does not change the acting identity. Cannot be combined with userId or user_memory.

message.description: What you want to find, do, or discuss.

mode.description: Omit for Auto. Search returns indexed matches; live_search asks providers for current task fit; execute coordinates work; route opens primed agent threads for direct interaction; chat discusses. Approvals still apply.

sessionId.description: Session to continue. Omit to start a new session.

target.description: Explicit agent target. Bypasses Darwin discovery; it never grants execution authority.

user_memory.description: Markdown preferences to personalize this request. Read a .md file and pass its text, not a path or URL. With userId, saves these preferences for later requests; empty text clears them.
